item.title: Multiple Cars Damaged By Pothole
item.description: A number of drivers suffered burst tyres after hitting a large pothole on a road near Desborough yesterday evening. Police were called to scene on Oakley Road in Pipewell just before 5pm, after up to nine vehicles had been damaged. Drivers reported blow-outs and buckled wheels. item.title: Traffic Lights Restored After Springfield Street Crash
item.description: The main traffic lights at the entrance to the Sainsbury’s car park on Springfield Street in Market Harborough are now back up and running. item.description: Market Harborough’s new Banking Hub has opened in St Mary’s Place. item.description: Strikes by Arriva bus workers in Leicestershire have been put on hold after the company made an improved pay offer. item.description: The green light has been given for a new peregrine falcon nesting platform on the Symington Building in Market Harborough.
